# Blank identifier parameters are renamed to _p0, _p1, ... to avoid a gotip
# GOEXPERIMENT=simd compiler bug where _ params in simd-using functions produce
# "cannot use _ as value or type". Only the functions loopvec rewrites are
# renamed: Offset reads the package-level _p0, which a parameter of that name
# would hide, and so do Local, which also has a variable named simd, and the
# first blank function.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

var _p0 = 5

func Offset(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func Local(_ int) int {
	simd := struct{ x int }{1}
	return _p0 + simd.x
}

func _(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func FillBlankParams(_ int, _ byte, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 1
	}
}

func _(_ int, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 2
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

var _p0 = 5

func Offset(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func Local(_ int) int {
	simd := struct{ x int }{1}
	return _p0 + simd.x
}

func _(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func FillBlankParams(_p0 int, _p1 byte, dst []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	{
		_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_vcFloat32s0.Store(_c1)
			_vcFloat32s0.Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_vcFloat32s0.Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_vcFloat32s0.Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_vcFloat32s0.Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_n := _vcFloat32s0.StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}

func _(_p2 int, dst []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(2)
	{
		_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
		_count := len(_w1)
		_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
		for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
			_c1 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes]
			_vcFloat32s1.Store(_c1)
			_vcFloat32s1.Store(_c1[_lanes:])
			_vcFloat32s1.Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
			_vcFloat32s1.Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
		}
		for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
			_vcFloat32s1.Store(_w1[_i:])
		}
		for _i < _count {
			_n := _vcFloat32s1.StorePart(_w1[_i:])
			_i += _n
		}
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 2 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

var _p0 = 5

func Offset(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func Local(_ int) int {
	simd := struct{ x int }{1}
	return _p0 + simd.x
}

func _(_ int) int { return _p0 }

func FillBlankParams(_ int, _ byte, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 1
	}
}

func _(_ int, dst []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = 2
	}
}
